cases.name: eval-text-ascii-case-ignored
cases.note: Custom parameters compare ignoring case; also the covered control for the text cases below.

cases.name: eval-text-different-text-not-equal
cases.note: Uncovered control for the text cases below.

cases.name: eval-text-long-s-equals-s
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '017F;LATIN SMALL LETTER LONG S;...;0053;;0053': U+017F maps to U+0053, the pattern's S.

cases.name: eval-text-s-equals-long-s-pattern
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '017F;...;0053;;0053' and '0073;LATIN SMALL LETTER S;...;0053;;0053': both map to U+0053.

cases.name: eval-text-dotless-i-equals-i
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0131;LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I;...;0049;;0049' and '0069;LATIN SMALL LETTER I;...;0049;;0049': both map to U+0049.

cases.name: eval-text-dotted-capital-i-not-i
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0130;LATIN CAPITAL LETTER I WITH DOT ABOVE;...;;0069;' has no simple uppercase mapping, so it stays U+0130, while 'i' maps to U+0049. A comparison through lowercase would equate them.

cases.name: eval-text-kelvin-sign-not-k
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '212A;KELVIN SIGN;...;;006B;' has no simple uppercase mapping, so it stays U+212A, while 'k' maps to U+004B. Case folding or lowercasing would equate them.

cases.name: eval-text-sharp-s-not-ss
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '00DF;LATIN SMALL LETTER SHARP S;Ll;...;;;;;' has no simple uppercase mapping; the full mapping to 'SS' is not used.

cases.name: eval-text-sharp-s-not-capital-sharp-s
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '00DF;...;;;;;' has no uppercase mapping and '1E9E;LATIN CAPITAL LETTER SHARP S;...;;00DF;' has none either, so U+00DF and U+1E9E stay distinct. Lowercasing or simple case folding would equate them.

cases.name: eval-text-final-sigma-equals-sigma
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '03C2;GREEK SMALL LETTER FINAL SIGMA;...;03A3;;03A3' and '03C3;GREEK SMALL LETTER SIGMA;...;03A3;;03A3': both map to U+03A3. A comparison through lowercase would keep them distinct.

cases.name: eval-text-micro-sign-equals-mu
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '00B5;MICRO SIGN;...;039C;;039C' and '03BC;GREEK SMALL LETTER MU;...;039C;;039C': both map to U+039C.

cases.name: eval-text-deseret-small-equals-capital
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '10428;DESERET SMALL LETTER LONG I;...;10400;;10400': U+10428 maps to U+10400, outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, so a comparison over UTF-16 code units would miss it.

cases.name: eval-text-no-normalization
cases.note: U+00E9 against U+0065 U+0301: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '00E9;...;00C9;;00C9' maps to U+00C9, and U+0065 U+0301 map to U+0045 U+0301; the code points differ and no normalization applies.

cases.name: eval-text-source-name-case-ignored
cases.note: Source names compare ignoring case, so the trusted source 'winget' trusts 'WINGET'.

cases.name: eval-text-source-name-dotless-i
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0131;...;0049;;0049': the trusted source 'wınget' and the source 'winget' both map to 'WINGET'.

cases.name: eval-text-source-name-dotted-capital-i
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0130;...;;0069;' has no uppercase mapping, so the trusted source 'wİnget' differs from 'winget' and does not trust it. Control: eval-text-source-name-dotless-i.

cases.name: eval-text-install-location-long-s
cases.note: Install locations compare ignoring case; UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '017F;...;0053;;0053' maps the location's last character to the pattern's S.

cases.name: eval-pattern-star-matches-empty
cases.note: '*' matches zero characters.

cases.name: eval-pattern-whole-value-not-prefix
cases.note: A pattern matches the whole value, not a prefix of it.

cases.name: eval-pattern-whole-value-not-suffix
cases.note: A pattern matches the whole value, not a suffix of it.

cases.name: eval-pattern-stars-out-of-order
cases.note: The literal characters must appear in the pattern's order.

cases.name: eval-pattern-star-backtracks
cases.note: '*' matches 'a', then 'ab' matches; a matcher that commits to the first 'a' misses this.

cases.name: eval-pattern-literals-do-not-overlap
cases.note: Each literal character matches its own character, so 'a*a' needs at least two characters.

cases.name: eval-pattern-question-mark-is-literal
cases.note: Only '*' is a wildcard; '?' matches only itself.

cases.name: eval-pattern-brackets-are-literal
cases.note: Brackets form no character class.

cases.name: eval-pattern-backslash-does-not-escape-star
cases.note: With no escape character, 'a\*' is 'a', a literal backslash, then '*'; the value has no backslash.

cases.name: eval-pattern-backslash-is-literal
cases.note: With no escape character, 'a\*' matches 'a', a backslash, then any sequence.

cases.name: eval-text-sharp-s-not-full-uppercase-ss
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '00DF;LATIN SMALL LETTER SHARP S;Ll;0;L;;;;;N;;;;;' has no simple uppercase mapping, so U+00DF stays itself and differs from 'SS'; SpecialCasing.txt 16.0.0 line '00DF; 00DF; 0053 0073; 0053 0053; # LATIN SMALL LETTER SHARP S' gives the full uppercase 'SS', which the comparison does not use. Control: eval-text-ss-equals-uppercase-ss.

cases.name: eval-text-ss-equals-uppercase-ss
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0073;LATIN SMALL LETTER S;...;0053;;0053' maps each 's' to 'S'.

cases.name: eval-text-source-name-ss-equals-uppercase-ss
cases.note: The trusted source 'STRASSE' trusts 'strasse', which differs from 'straße' only in 'ss'.

cases.name: eval-text-source-name-selector-sharp-s-not-ss
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '00DF;...' has no simple uppercase mapping, so the trusted source 'straße' maps to 'STRAßE' and does not trust 'STRASSE'. Control: eval-text-source-name-ss-equals-uppercase-ss.

cases.name: eval-text-ligature-ff-not-full-uppercase-ff
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line 'FB00;LATIN SMALL LIGATURE FF;Ll;0;L;<compat> 0066 0066;;;;N;;;;;' has no simple uppercase mapping, so U+FB00 differs from 'FF'; SpecialCasing.txt 16.0.0 line 'FB00; FB00; 0046 0066; 0046 0046; # LATIN SMALL LIGATURE FF' gives the full uppercase 'FF', which the comparison does not use, and compatibility normalization would also equate them. Control: eval-text-ff-equals-uppercase-ff.

cases.name: eval-text-ff-equals-uppercase-ff
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0066;LATIN SMALL LETTER F;...;0046;;0046' maps each 'f' to 'F'.

cases.name: eval-text-n-apostrophe-not-full-uppercase
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '0149;LATIN SMALL LETTER N PRECEDED BY APOSTROPHE;Ll;...;;;;' has no simple uppercase mapping, so U+0149 differs from U+02BC U+004E; SpecialCasing.txt 16.0.0 line '0149; 0149; 02BC 004E; 02BC 004E; # LATIN SMALL LETTER N PRECEDED BY APOSTROPHE' gives that full uppercase, which the comparison does not use. Control: eval-text-apostrophe-n-equals-uppercase.

cases.name: eval-text-apostrophe-n-equals-uppercase
cases.note: U+02BC U+006E against U+02BC U+004E: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '02BC;MODIFIER LETTER APOSTROPHE;Lm;0;L;;;;;N;;;;;' has no uppercase mapping and UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '006E;LATIN SMALL LETTER N;...;004E;;004E' maps 'n' to 'N'.

cases.name: eval-text-alpha-ypogegrammeni-equals-simple-uppercase
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '1F80;GREEK SMALL LETTER ALPHA WITH PSILI AND YPOGEGRAMMENI;Ll;...;1F88;;1F88' maps U+1F80 to U+1F88, the pattern, which UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '1F88;GREEK CAPITAL LETTER ALPHA WITH PSILI AND PROSGEGRAMMENI;Lt;...;;1F80;' leaves as itself. The simple mapping applies even where SpecialCasing.txt gives a different full one.

cases.name: eval-text-alpha-ypogegrammeni-not-full-uppercase
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '1F80;...;1F88;;1F88' maps U+1F80 to U+1F88, which differs from the pattern U+1F08 U+0399; SpecialCasing.txt 16.0.0 line '1F80; 1F80; 1F88; 1F08 0399; # GREEK SMALL LETTER ALPHA WITH PSILI AND YPOGEGRAMMENI' gives that pair as the full uppercase, which the comparison does not use. Control: eval-text-alpha-psili-iota-equals-uppercase.

cases.name: eval-text-alpha-prosgegrammeni-not-full-uppercase
cases.note: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '1F88;...;Lt;...;;1F80;' has no simple uppercase mapping, so U+1F88 stays itself and differs from the pattern U+1F08 U+0399; SpecialCasing.txt 16.0.0 line '1F88; 1F80; 1F88; 1F08 0399; # GREEK CAPITAL LETTER ALPHA WITH PSILI AND PROSGEGRAMMENI' gives that pair as the full uppercase, which the comparison does not use. Control: eval-text-alpha-psili-iota-equals-uppercase.

cases.name: eval-text-alpha-psili-iota-equals-uppercase
cases.note: U+1F00 U+03B9 against U+1F08 U+0399: UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '1F00;GREEK SMALL LETTER ALPHA WITH PSILI;...;1F08;;1F08' and UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line '03B9;GREEK SMALL LETTER IOTA;...;0399;;0399' map the parameter to the pattern.
